status: portable fresh-training bootstrap verified; historical research weights remain unpublished

generated.scope: Original generated benchmark, with unchanged source split and loss definition; response probabilities are environment-only

demandBootstrap.observationModel: Complete totals use density; censored totals use an aggregate lower-bound survival score, which is not generally the likelihood of separately censored daily observations

training.objective: Train source-held-out family NLL regression; minimum predicted loss

encoderIntegration.scope: Published snapshot plus newly trained GRU and pinned pretrained ModernBERT; one optimizer step, not an effectiveness experiment

expectedRejections: A checkpoint prepared on the previous workspace capture was rejected against the public snapshot; neither data identities nor checkpoint metadata were weakened.
An empty local pretrained cache fails in offline mode; the verified path reused only the public, pinned pretrained ModernBERT cache.
limitations: Exact historical checkpoint reevaluation and full expanded-data capture are not published.
Aggregate censoring demand objective remains an acknowledged modeling issue.
This bootstrap test does not establish statistical effectiveness or final Test performance.
